rules: Use Pike/SNW visual language only where source-backed.
Do not import later-era LCARS, uniforms or standard technologies without explicit exception.
Exact campaign date may narrow the broad era profile.
Kirk is a broad era with substantial internal visual evolution.
Exact date/subperiod must resolve before uniform/interior/equipment generation.
Do not flatten TOS and film-era presentation into one style.
TNG, DS9 and Voyager coexist only when date permits.
Organization/platform context chooses the correct local visual language.
Do not treat all late-24th-century interiors/uniforms as visually identical.
